basics.name: Pedro Azevedo
basics.label: Engineering Manager
basics.summary: I am an Engineering Manager who bridges the gap between business goals and technical execution. I maintain a hands-on approach to software architecture while focusing on building high-performing teams. I have a proven track record of scaling engineering organizations and establishing modern developer cultures from the ground up.

highlights: Lead cross-functional teams to deliver end-to-end projects with a focus on code quality and sustainable team velocity.
Manage a diverse portfolio of technical projects across web, mobile, and cloud infrastructure.
Serve as the primary technical interface for stakeholders, translating business requirements into actionable technical roadmaps.
Founded the company's internal Tech Chapter to standardize practices around security, platform stability, and automated testing.
Refined the interview pipeline and established a structured career growth framework for the engineering team.
Established 1:1s and provided mentorship and support individual career development across the team.
Designed and built high-throughput distributed systems and cloud-native services using several technologies such as C#, Angular, Python and Azure.
Automated infrastructure provisioning and deployment workflows using Terraform and GitHub Actions.
Led technical discovery workshops with clients and acted as the technical lead within embedded client squads.
Directed the technical strategy for a large-scale digital transformation, scaling the effort from a single team to over 10 cross-functional squads.
Defined architectural boundaries using Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to manage complex business logic across backend and infrastructure teams.
Established a 'Subject Matter Expert' (SME) framework to decentralize knowledge and provide developers with ownership over technical domains.
Developed core retail technology, including POS and kitchen management systems, for high-volume environments.
Owned the migration and deployment of on-premise systems for various international markets.
Maintained legacy C++/Java systems while implementing modern service features in C#.
